Subject: Preliminary comp-delta analysis for remote hires (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for taking a look at this. We ran a quick comp-delta analysis across the roles you've been hiring for (SWE IC, SRE, PM). Attached is a short PDF with median market movement and two suggested uplift bands to align offers in EU and APAC while keeping US base ranges stable.

High-level points:
- EU (western markets) shows a +6–10% median vs current bands for senior ICs.
- APAC (SG/HK/JP) varies: Singapore +4–8%, Japan +8–12% depending on seniority.
- Recommended approach: introduce a Location Pay Matrix that maps a comp-ratio multiplier by band and region, capped at a budgeted % uplift per role.

Attachment: comp-ratio_analysis_20270522.pdf (2 pages)

Would love to sync with you and HR (and product/eng leads) to understand headcount impact if we take the conservative band vs the aggressive band. Do you want me to prepare a matrix spreadsheet with candidate-ready offer numbers?

Best,

Subject: Re: Preliminary comp-delta analysis for remote hires (US/EU/APAC) — matrix attached

Evelyn / team — attached is the draft location_pay_matrix_v1.xlsx. Summary of recommendations below (short version):

- Method: start from current US band medians, apply region multipliers, then round to nearest $1k and cap by role budget limits. We kept on-target total comp (OTC) parity where possible.
- Proposed multipliers (conservative band): EU (Western) x1.06; APAC Singapore x1.04; APAC Japan x1.08.
- Aggressive band available in sheet (EU x1.10, SG x1.08, JP x1.12) flagged with comment cells.
- For senior IC roles (IC4+), recommend hard caps: max +8% (conservative) / +12% (aggressive) to limit offer inflation.

Headcount impact quick math (conservative band):
- 20 planned headcount hires in Q3 (mix SWE/SRE/PM) -> incremental salary run-rate increase ~ $420k annualized.
- We can absorb ~60% of that within current hiring budget; remainder requires a one-time budget uplift or shifting some roles to later quarters. See sheet 'BudgetImpact'.

Attachments: location_pay_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), comp-ratio_analysis_20270522.pdf (from Carmen).

Next steps I recommend:
- Marcus: confirm whether budget uplift is feasible for Q3 or if we must stagger hires.
- Karthik: please confirm whether offers for EMEA candidates need additional legal review (local contract language) before we finalize template changes.

Happy to iterate — I left comments in the Aggressive band cells to explain tradeoffs.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Compensation & Benefits
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Preliminary comp-delta analysis for remote hires (US/EU/APAC) — approval to proceed (conservative)

Team — reviewed Laura's matrix and Carmen's analysis. Approve proceeding with the conservative multipliers effective immediately for new offers (EU x1.06; SG x1.04; JP x1.08) with the following conditions:

1) Cap senior IC increases at +8% as recommended.
2) Recruiting to flag any candidate offers above the conservative cap for pre-approval.
3) Finance will track the incremental run-rate in the hiring dashboard and present a Q3 variance explanation if total annualized impact exceeds $400k.

Evelyn / Laura: please coordinate with People Ops to implement offer-template logic and update the recruiting playbook. Karthik: please confirm any local contract checks for EMEA before we finalize.

Thanks — Marcus
